fields.Name: User Impersonation Started
fields.Description: An authorized user started a temporary impersonation session. Fail-closed: if this audit row fails to save, the minted key is immediately revoked and deleted before returning. Details JSON captures actorUserId, actorEmail, targetUserId, targetEmail, apiKeyId, mode ('ViewAs' | 'ActAs'), readOnly, ttlMinutes, expiresAt, ipAddress, and userAgent (never rawApiKey).

fields.Name: User Impersonation Ended
fields.Description: A temporary user impersonation session ended and its scoped API key was revoked and cleaned up. Details JSON captures actorUserId, targetUserId, apiKeyId, ipAddress, and userAgent.

fields.Name: User Impersonation Denied
fields.Description: A user impersonation request was denied by server-side infrastructure kill-switch, authorization, anti-chaining, header-smuggling, or target privilege-ceiling checks.
